_note: No indefinite articles anywhere. 'a apple' vs 'an apple' would make the carrier text ungrammatical for vowel-initial words, which is a property of the word rather than of its membership, and it would show up in the geometry as a real difference between words for a reason that has nothing to do with the experiment. Every template is also a QUESTION or an explicit request. A declarative like 'The picture shows [-placeholder-].' is not a prompt an instruct model answers -- it replies asking what you mean, and 120 of 200 responses come back as word-independent boilerplate that teaches the template instead of the word. Check with cell 5b of run_v1.ipynb after generating.
